name: join
summary: Join the lines of two sorted files that share a key field

options.description: fields are separated by CHAR (default: runs of blanks, printed as one space)
the key is field FIELD of the first file (default 1)
the key is field FIELD of the second file (default 1)
the key is field FIELD of both files
also print the lines of file FILENUM (1 or 2) that have no match; may be repeated
print only the lines of file FILENUM that have no match
print the fields in FORMAT: a comma- or space-separated list of FILENUM.FIELD or 0 (the key), or auto (as many fields as each file's first line)
with -o, print STRING for a missing field
compare keys without regard to case
treat the first line of each file as a header and print it joined, unchecked
accepted and ignored (the input is taken as sorted)
accepted and ignored (the input is taken as sorted)

notes: Keys compare byte by byte, as in the C.UTF-8 locale; unsorted input gives incomplete output without a warning.

messages.badFileNumber: invalid file number in field spec: {spec:locale}
